CustomField.description: How many Pending Customer Signature emails this mandate has had - 1 for the first send, incremented by each reminder. Reset to 1 whenever the mandate re-enters Pending Customer Signature, so it counts the current signing cycle rather than the record's whole life. The audit trail for the chase: with logEmailOnSend off there is no EmailMessage to look at.
CustomField.label: Pending Signature Email Count
